segments.he:
ב.

לְפִי הַזְּקֵנִים שֶׁבַּדּוֹר כֵּן הַפַּרְנָסָה.
segments.en: The elders uphold Israel, and their advice is good for us.

segments.he:
א.

זְקֵנִים מַעֲמִידִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַעֲצָתָם טוֹבָה לָנוּ. ג.

אִם הַזְּקֵנִים אֵינָם חֲכָמִים סִימָן לַדָּבָר - שֶׁעִקַּר חֲשִׁיבוּתָם הוּא אֵצֶל נָשִׁים הַיְלָדוֹת.
segments.en:
The elders uphold Israel, and their advice is good for us.

According to the elderly of the generation, so is the income.

If the elders are not wise, a sign of the matter is that their main esteem is by young women.
